scope: Live authenticated Batch 2 build passed planning, then the SoftwareAgent made 40 model calls in about 3 minutes (about $0.68) without finishing. The Cline SDK Agent has no iteration limit unless maxIterations is set. Set a finite ceiling of 60 on both Agent constructions and log each tool step (step number, tool name, argument key names only) to see which call repeats.

keep: Completion gate, checkpointing and provider budget reservation are unchanged
extend: The software agent loop now has a finite iteration ceiling and per-step diagnostics

schemaImpact.rollback: Revert the commit and redeploy the previous image.

egress.description: No egress change; the line goes to the existing process log only.

cost.description: Reduces risk: bounds model calls per software-agent run. No new spend path.

tests.scope: Every Agent construction has a finite maxIterations; the step log carries only step, tool name and argument key names. 49 PASS.

architecture.reason: Adds a limit and a log line to the existing SoftwareAgent executor. No new orchestrator or control plane.

rollout: Merge after required checks, build the release image, create a 0% revision, switch traffic with the Job, then repeat the authenticated build.
rollback: Revert the commit and redeploy; restore the previous service revision and Job image and label.
knownGaps: The root cause of the repeated step is not fixed; the cap bounds cost and the log shows the repeating tool
placeholderClaimsRemaining: Batch 2 building is not accepted until a live authenticated build saves a revision
